title: Scholarship: The Game (First Draft)
author: Gray Manichean
description:
A silly game I wrote to learn how to use the GameBook Authoring Tool, though I didn't like its output, so I moved it all over to Twine. This is just the beginning, but it's the first time for me to publish any gamebook thing, so I hope you like the draft.
I plan to make something really happen in further versions. For right now, you can see my absurdist side here.
I just finished another straightforward game called "Burning Questions" about escaping from a burning building.
